I have farmed this land in Kaskazini Pemba for many years without any schooling. This small plot of 0.08 hectares is not big enough to waste money on bought fertilizer, new seeds, or hired workers. I will work it myself with my family using what we know from our fathers, and we will depend on the rains as we always have.
